dedupe_keys.name: inwatersense sitnica river ten minute water quality measurements

description: InWaterSense provides temperature, electrical conductivity, pH and dissolved-oxygen measurements from two sensor nodes on the Sitnica River at Plemetin, Kosovo. The University of Prishtina project places the nodes about one hundred metres apart and records observations every ten minutes from May 2015 to early January 2016. More than one hundred thousand parameter observations are supplied in long and timestamp-grouped forms, with CSV, Excel and SQL files. Mendeley licenses the release under CC BY-NC 3.0 with free public access; commercial reuse is restricted. Coverage is limited to two nearby nodes, and parameter-wise rows must not be mistaken for independent four-variable time points. These data do not establish water quality across Kosovo. A reviewer-assessed use is simulating sensor outages or source-water quality assumptions. model-epanet and platform-ns-3 provide related water and communications modelling environments, requiring separate physical inputs. No sensor record or SQL transformation was executed.
